## Status Definitions Reference

**Implementation Status:** Not Implemented, Placeholder, Partially Implemented, Implemented, Deprecated
**Validation Status:** Not Tested, Unit Verified, Integration Verified, Runtime Verified, Fully Verified
**Runtime Status:** Working, Working (Fallback), Working (Conditional), Placeholder, Disabled, Broken
**Production Readiness:** Ready, Conditional, Blocked, Deferred
